The Alternative Blend

R185,00 – R585,00

The Alternative blend has been the go-to house blend for Sbcc since our inception in 2018. It is a three-bean blend comprising of African and South American origin. Characteristic notes of chocolate, deep and dark fruits as well as pleasant hazelnut typify this medium roast. Hallmarked for its versatility from filter to espresso.
